welcome.title: Welcome to Code Royale!
welcome.intro: You are the Commander of the Blue Kingdom. But your fighters only listen to… code!

steps.title: Write code
steps.text: Your code gives orders to the BLUE army. Every fighter runs it many times per second.

steps.title: Press FIGHT!
steps.text: Watch your army battle the RED team. Did your plan work?

steps.title: Earn stars
steps.text: Win to unlock new levels, new fighters and new tricks. Can you get all the stars?

spy.title: 🕵️ Red team's secret code
spy.intro: You sneaked into the red camp and found their battle plan! Every red fighter runs this code. Can you find a weakness?

console.title: Console
console.empty: Messages from log(...) and errors show up here. Try adding log(me.name, me.health) to your code!

debugger.restartTip: Back to the first line of this tick

guide.title: 📖 Commander's Guide
guide.commandsIntro: Your code runs for each of your fighters, 20 times every second. me is the fighter running the code right now.

rules.title: A fair fight
rules.text: In most levels both teams have exactly the same army. The only difference is the CODE. The red team gets cleverer level after level, but it always has a weakness to find!

rules.title: Fighting style
rules.text: Your fighters already know how to fight: once me.attack() gets them close, knights circle their target and lunge in to strike, while archers, scouts and mages keep their distance and side-step between shots. Each hit pushes the target back a little.

rules.title: Target rings
rules.text: A spinning ring under a fighter means someone is attacking it: a blue ring for your team, a red ring for theirs. ×3 means three fighters are ganging up on it!

rules.title: Decision icons
rules.text: Every time your code makes a fighter change what it does, a small icon pops up: ⚔️ attack, 🔍 explore, 👣 follow, 🌀 circle, 🌿 hide, 💨 escape, ✋ wait, 📍 move, 🔁 patrol. 💤 means it got no orders at all!

rules.title: Detection radius
rules.text: Each fighter spots enemies inside its detection radius (me.sight). Hover a fighter in the arena to see its circle. Scouts see the furthest!

rules.title: Shared vision
rules.text: Your team shares what it sees. If ONE fighter spots an enemy, it shows up in everybody's enemies list. Enemies nobody sees are NOT in the list.

rules.title: Bushes
rules.text: Fighters in a bush are hidden: enemies only spot them from very close ({{bushDetect}}), except scouts ({{scoutBushDetect}}). Use me.hide() to go hide in the nearest bush.

rules.title: Attacking makes noise
rules.text: When you attack, enemies can spot you from further away for a moment, and you're no longer hidden in your bush. Hit… then move!

rules.title: Rocks
rules.text: Rocks block the way AND block sight. Nobody can see through a rock: hide behind one!

rules.title: Spotted!
rules.text: A yellow ! pops up when your team spots an enemy. A red ! and a 👁 above your fighter mean the ENEMY can see it (me.isSpotted is true). A ? shows where an enemy disappeared.

rules.title: Fog of war
rules.text: The dark areas are what your team can't see. Switch the Fog off under the arena to watch like a spectator.

js.title: Nothing there? null!
js.text: When there's nothing to find, me.nearestEnemy() gives null. if (enemy) is true only when something was found.

js.title: Remember something
js.text: let makes a variable: a named box to keep a value in.

js.title: Make a choice
js.text: if runs code only when something is true. else runs when it's not.

js.title: Compare things
js.text: <  smaller than,  >  bigger than,  ==  equal,  !=  not equal

js.title: And / Or / Not
js.text: && means AND (both true), || means OR (one is enough), ! means NOT.

js.title: Stop here
js.text: return stops the code for this fighter right now.

js.title: Search a list
js.text: find gives the first match. filter gives all matches. length counts them.
js.code:
let mages = enemies.filter(e => e.type == "mage")
log("Mages:", mages.length)

js.title: Loop over a list
js.text: for ... of looks at each thing in a list, one by one.

js.title: Do some math
js.text: + - * / work like on a calculator. Math.abs, Math.min, Math.max can help too.

syntax.unclosed: Something was opened but never closed. Look for a missing ")" or "}".
syntax.unexpectedToken: Oops! Something is written in a way I don't understand here. Check for a missing ( ) { } or a typo.
syntax.unterminatedString: A text in "quotes" is not closed. Add the missing quote!
syntax.unexpectedCharacter: There's a strange character here that doesn't belong in code.
syntax.alreadyDeclared: "{{name}}" already exists. Use a different name, or remove "let" the second time.

runtime.notDefined: I don't know what "{{name}}" is. Is it spelled right? (Capital letters matter!)
runtime.missingProperty: Tried to use ".{{property}}" on something that doesn't exist (it's {{value}}). Maybe there is no enemy left? Try checking with if (thing) { ... }
runtime.notAFunction: "{{name}}" is not something I can run. Check the spelling, and look in the 📖 Guide for the right name.
runtime.stackOverflow: Your code calls itself forever! (Maximum call stack exceeded)
runtime.endlessLoop: This loop never stops! It went round more than {{max, number}} times in a single tick.

debug.reservedName: Names starting with "{{prefix}}" are used by the debugger. Please pick another name.
debug.noBreakpointHit: No fighter reached a breakpoint before the end of the battle.
debug.battleOver: The battle is already over at this moment.
debug.pickBlueFighter: Pick one of your blue fighters to debug.
debug.knockedOut: {{name}} is knocked out at this moment, so its code doesn't run.

warn.blind: 👀 Your fighters are just standing there: they can't SEE any enemy! Enemies only show up inside a fighter's detection radius. Try adding: else { me.explore() }
warn.attackPoint: me.attack() needs a fighter (like me.nearestEnemy()), not a place. To walk somewhere use me.moveTo(x, y).
warn.friendlyFire: Whoa! You told a fighter to attack someone on YOUR team. I ignored that. 😅
warn.patrolNeedsPlaces: me.patrol() needs a list of places, like me.patrol([[200, 150], [200, 450]])
warn.noBush: There are no bushes in this arena to hide in! 🌳
warn.tooManyLogs: That's a LOT of messages! I stopped showing them after {{max}}.

app.codeStuck: Your code got stuck! 🌀 It's probably a loop that never ends (like a while loop whose condition is always true). Check your loops and try again.
app.traceStuck: Your code got stuck before this moment: probably a loop that never ends. 🌀
app.noFighterStanding: None of your fighters is standing at this moment.
app.needBreakpoint: Click left of a line number to put a 🔴 breakpoint there. Then Continue runs the battle until a fighter reaches it.
app.battleEnd: That's the end of the battle! 🏁
